messages:
Alex: Heads up  Ornith dedicated (ornith-prod <-> onprem-lon) had a short isolation during a KV checkpoint at 08:17 UTC. Not a full outage but ~40s of degraded RPCs.
Maya: Can you paste the initial logs or link the ticket?
Alex: Ticket attached: PM-8801. pcap and bgp counters uploaded. I also see a spike in tcp retransmit rate coincident with `kv.checkpoint.start`.
Ben: Looks familiar. We observed similar transient congestion with Kestrel and Helix last quarter. Suspect checkpoint collision + egress queueing on customer edge.
Claire: Ornith-NOC sent syslogs showing TCP segmentation and MTU warnings around the same time.
Ornith-NOC: We applied a rapid policy change at 08:18 to drop large flows; can share full syslog.
Maya: Immediate triage: 1) assign remediation owner, 2) enable 48h ring pcap for the peering pair, 3) add correlation alert (checkpoint_active AND retransmit_pct>0.9%).
Alex: I'll take remediation owner and customer coordination.
Ben: I'll add pcap hooks and extend tcpdump rotation. ETA: 12h.
Claire: I'll update observability to include kv.checkpoint.size and kv.checkpoint.start_ts in peering dashboard for 60 days.
Maya: Ops-bot please create the postmortem issue and tag `peering-cadence` and `recurring-regression`.
ops-bot: Created issue PM-8801 with labels `peering-cadence, recurring-regression`. Template `pm-onprem-peering-v1` applied.
Alex: Recording action items: Alex  owner & RCA doc (72h), Ben  pcap hooks + PR (EOD tomorrow), Claire  dashboard fields (24h), Maya  coordinate WG and customer note (48h).
Ben: For alert rule: trigger when (bgp_flap OR tcp_retransmit_pct>0.9) AND kv.checkpoint.active == true, route to #incidents + paging. I'll add as a staged rule.
Claire: Propose mitigation sprint: jitter checkpoint windows by tenant group and add soft pacing when net.egress.drop_pct > 0.5% for >10s. Recommend 7-day pilot.
Maya: I'll spin up a short-lived WG (Runtime + Platform SRE + Customer Netops). Invite to go out today.
Ornith-NOC: We'll run MTU checks and share any additional captures. Happy to participate in WG.
Alex: Also adding retrospective item: correlate checkpoint start times across Ornith, Kestrel, and Nova to find cadence overlaps. Assign Ben + Platform SRE.
ops-bot: Reminder: attach `pcap_PM-8801.pcap` and `bgp_08_17.log` to PM-8801 and set weekly follow-up cadence until mitigations verified.
Ben: Logging note: include `kv.checkpoint.seed`, `kv.checkpoint.duration_ms`, and `net.egress.drop_pct` in peering traces for 90 days to help correlation.
Claire: I'll add those fields and share dashboard link in the PM issue.
Maya: Customer-facing draft: "We've assigned a remediation lead and are investigating intermittent peering degradation during KV checkpointing. Expect initial mitigation plan within 72 hours." Alex confirm?
Alex: Confirmed. I'll post RCA timeline and draft mitigation plan to PM-8801 by EOD tomorrow.
Maya: Thanks all. Closing thread for now; WG invite will contain the sprint goals and owner list. :thumbsup:
